registry_disposition.reason: S8 owner authority and canonical export regeneration, executed under the scoped residual closure run directive of 2026-10-21 (S7/S8 residual obligations). It closes the two OPEN obligations recorded by the predecessor S8 run (evidence/skill-promotion-2026-10-20/RUN.md). FIRST, the owner approval is no longer a self-declared object: a self-declared canonical_owner name and a free decision_ref are caller input and authorize nothing. The approval is now an artifact in the canonical decision surface core/authority/approvals/ of the target tree, verified against the canonical owner trust anchor core/contracts/owner-authority.json (new contracts core/contracts/owner-authority.schema.json and core/contracts/owner-approval.schema.json): the signing key must be published, active and hold the canonical_owner role, the Ed25519 signature must verify over the canonical body (skill, decision, time, candidate digest), the approval must name the exact promoted skill and the exact candidate content, the decision may not be dated in the future and may not be older than the declared age bound, and the approval artifact digest is re-verified in the post-adoption readback. The CLI accepts an allowlist of inputs and pins the trust anchor to the canonical location of its own installation, so an input file can never point the promotion at an anchor the caller controls, and it pins the evidence age bound as well. The committed anchor ships with authority_status PENDING_PUBLICATION and no key, so every approval is refused fail-closed until the owner publishes the canonical owner public key there: no authority is minted by this change. The adoption record names the anchor that vouched (owner_approval.authority_digest). SECOND, the canonical export regeneration is performed: the neutral core registry and every provider export are rebuilt from the canonical tree by the canonical generators (no second implementation), bound to the adoption digest, and read back; the regenerated registry must contain the adopted skill, a symlinked export surface is refused, and an incomplete regeneration fails closed and restores the canonical file AND every export surface (each restore independent, a failing restore reported as a named failure instead of a silently half-applied adoption). The contract core/contracts/skill-promotion-adoption.schema.json makes owner_approval.signature_verified and export_regeneration.performed const true: an adoption without a verified approval and a performed export regeneration is not representable. The new runtime modules are runtime/skills/owner-authority.mjs and runtime/skills/export-regeneration.mjs; the promotion runner scripts/tools/promote-skill-candidate.mjs enforces the chain; the new test file tests/vnext/skill-promotion.test.mjs carries 33 tests. SCOPE, explicitly not claimed: the specification stays PROPOSED, this run grants no capability, no permission, no qualification and no runtime authority (authority_granted stays const false); NO skill was promoted on a live canonical tree (the chain was exercised in isolated temp trees only, and a promotion on the live tree remains an owner act); the behavioral evidence side of the chain remains caller-asserted (pre-existing from the first S8 slice) while this run verifies the approval side; and the publication of the canonical owner public key into the trust anchor remains an OPEN owner obligation, not a delivered authority. The independent review was performed by a local audit agent (the codex review connector was quota-exhausted) over three rounds with mutation probes; every finding was real and repaired, and every claimed gate is now bound by at least one failing test; no human approval is claimed. The hosted GitHub Actions job could not execute (the account is locked for a billing issue); every CI step was replicated locally on the published head and the absence of a hosted run is disclosed rather than presented as a green gate. The Mimosa pre-commit scan did not produce a complete result for the commits of this change, so no security claim is derived from it. The Registry write is required and pending: the run change registration registry/MAWS_OWNER_AUTHORITY_EXPORT_REGENERATION_2026_10_21_001.yaml and the CONTRACT_RECORD projections registry/MAWS_OWNER_AUTHORITY_EXPORT_CONTRACT_2026_10_21_001.yaml are published after the source merge, and the Atlas representation follows the Registry. The owner-side classification is rebound from REQUIRED_BUT_BLOCKED to UPDATED with the registry commit sha after that publication; the recorded facts of the source change are unchanged.
